source.prompt: Melodic house song, about 3.5 minutes, 122 BPM, B minor. Emotive, moonlit and hopeful, the feeling of swimming out under the stars. Warm, soulful male lead vocal, smooth and close, with airy stacked harmonies on the chorus. Soft breathy flute melody, gentle harp arpeggios, lush legato string section pad, warm grand piano chords, rolling finger bass. Four-on-the-floor kick, claps on 2 and 4, offbeat open hats, soft shaker and light congas. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge with vocal, piano and strings, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, wide mix with a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[Intro]
Ooh, ooh

[Verse]
Lanterns on the jetty, burning low
Your laughter in the dark is all I know
We kicked away the hours on the sand
The ocean pulling softly at your hand

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't look back, the shore is fading
Something in the deep is waiting

[Chorus]
Follow the undertow, follow me down
Into the silver where no one can drown
Let the night carry us out past the glow
Hold on to me, follow the undertow

[Verse]
Starlight on your shoulders, salt and gold
A secret that the waves have always told
The music in the water keeps us near
Every heartbeat echoes, crystal clear

[Pre-Chorus]

Something in the deep is waiting

[Chorus]

Hold on to me, follow the undertow

[Bridge]
Ooh, let it go
Ooh, nice and slow
Out where the blue begins
I'll find you there again

[Chorus]
